name: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
benefit:
**BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows will receive a quarterly stipend and annual research grant as mentioned below:**

   1. Quarterly Stipend: INR 7,500/- per quarter per student of the team
   1. Annual research grant: INR 2,50,000/- per team
   1. EYCs, EYC knowledge partners, and BIRAC provide continuous mentoring support to fellows, including but not limited to Technical Mentoring, IP Support, Legal Supp
_eligibility_text:
1. Indian students from Indian Institutes/colleges who are pursuing under graduation in any domain should apply as a team.
   1. A team should comprise a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 Indian students from Indian Institutes/colleges pursuing under graduation in any domain.
   1. Teams with students from different disciplines are encouraged.
   1. One team can have students from the same/different colleges/institutes.
   1. The team should be supported by a mentor/guide.

**Note 01:** BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows shall pursue their research work at their College/University labs and will also be allowed access to facilities at EYC and EYC Knowledge Partners as and when required.
**Note 02:** It will be mandatory for all the fellows to spend 3-4 weeks at EYC/EYC Knowledge Partner during their fellowship period.
